facts.fact: The Vote 143 budget-performance document lists the Plan for National Statistical Development (PNSDIV) as an output with indicators on the proportion of MDAs/LGs/CSOs implementing the PNSD (base year 2023/24, targets 67% and 75% for 2026/27), so the plan is in force; no adoption date or period is given, and the document is dated by its published year only (2026).
